VERDICT: The implementation correctly enforces fail-closed corpus verification and accurately distinguishes control-header closures from ordinary division via backward paren balancing.
ACTION ITEMS: No concrete correctness gaps remain; the lexer logic, manifest validation, and test coverage are fully aligned with the specified requirements.
CORPUS CONSEQUENCE: Analysis is strictly gated to the pinned 228-file manifest, rejecting any missing, extra, or corrupted inputs before processing.
LEXER CONSEQUENCE: Slashy literals following control headers are correctly identified as fake, while ordinary parenthesized expressions followed by division remain executable code.
